# UK Car Imports

> Ireland's platform for importing used cars from the UK. Every listed price is
> all-in: the car delivered to Ireland, VRT and NOx paid, on Irish plates, in
> your name. Around 130,000 UK cars searchable, refreshed continuously.

## Key pages

- [Used cars](https://ukcarimports.ie/used-cars): full searchable stock with
  filters (make, model, fuel, price, mileage, year). Add `?bestseller=1` for
  cars priced under the comparable Irish market.
- [Bestseller Index](https://ukcarimports.ie/bestseller-index): weekly measured
  UK-vs-Ireland price comparison; methodology stated on the page.
- [How it works](https://ukcarimports.ie/how-it-works): the import process,
  step by step — deposit, optional inspection, shipping, VRT, Irish plates,
  roughly two weeks end to end.
- [Car sourcing](https://ukcarimports.ie/car-sourcing): paste any UK advert URL
  for an instant check (already in stock / seller restrictions / sourceable)
  and a landed-price estimate.
- [Contact](https://ukcarimports.ie/contact): phone 01-556 8261, Dublin-based,
  online-only (no showroom; handover by appointment).

## Notes for agents

- Each car page (`/car/{id}`) states the all-in euro price, full specification,
  vehicle history summary and photos; a price breakdown is available on-page.
- "Bestseller" badges mean the car is measurably cheaper than comparable cars
  advertised in Ireland; each badge links to the arithmetic behind the claim.
- Price-drop tags mean the UK dealer cut the asking price and the car is at
  the lowest price we have ever recorded for it.
- Deposits are payable online (Stripe); the balance settles by bank transfer.
